perplexity.description:
High Fidelity (A Hulu Original) is a soundtrack album released in 2020 by various artists, curated for the Hulu television series of the same name. The album blends classic soul, disco, and pop tracks with original songs and covers performed by cast members, reflecting the show’s deep connection to music culture. Featured artists include Ann Peebles, Darondo, Blondie, William Onyeabor, and Thomas Doherty, whose contributions range from iconic hits like “I Can’t Stand the Rain” and “Once I Had Love” to new interpretations and original compositions that capture the emotional arc of the series. The musical style is eclectic, emphasizing soulful vocals, vintage grooves, and contemporary indie-pop sensibilities, all woven together to mirror the protagonist’s journey through love, heartbreak, and self-discovery.

As a soundtrack, High Fidelity stands apart from traditional studio albums, serving as both a companion piece to the show and a standalone celebration of music’s role in storytelling. Released by Hollywood Records and Mondo Tees LLC, it marks a notable entry in the discographies of the featured artists, particularly for Thomas Doherty, whose original songs and covers are central to the album’s identity. The soundtrack received positive attention for its thoughtful curation and its ability to evoke the spirit of the original novel and film while updating the narrative for a modern audience. Though not a commercial blockbuster, it was praised by critics for its authenticity and emotional resonance, becoming a favorite among fans of the series and music enthusiasts alike.
